mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FOOD_TEST_RESULT ( FOOD_TEST_RESULT_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, RESULT_TYPE, RESULT_TITLE, RESULT_EMOJI, TAGS, RECOMMEND_MENU, ANSWERS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_FOOD_TEST_RESULT.NEXTVAL, #{memberSeq}, #{resultType}, #{resultTitle}, #{resultEmoji, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tags, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{recommendMenu, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{answers, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT FOOD_TEST_RESULT_SEQ AS foodTestResultSeq, MEMBER_SEQ AS memberSeq, RESULT_TYPE AS resultType, RESULT_TITLE AS resultTitle, RESULT_EMOJI AS resultEmoji, TAGS AS tags, RECOMMEND_MENU AS recommendMenu, ANSWERS AS answers, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM ( SELECT * FROM FOOD_TEST_RESULT WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} ORDER BY FOOD_TEST_RESULT_SEQ DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
